verdict.rationale: Cactus publishes a documented REST API for its platform. Documented endpoints include POST /generations, POST /tool_schemas, a three-call upload flow, training parameters and GET /billing, all described in an OpenAPI spec at /v1/openapi.json. The docs say the platform can be run from a coding agent with an API key. The probe 404s were only at the standard root OpenAPI paths and do not contradict the /v1 spec. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted REST API, documented auth/rate-limit and error-handling details in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: POST /generations with your tools, a count of 100 to 10,000 examples, and ideally a product description and a few example messages.
POST /tool_schemas with a product description of 10 to 1,000 characters returns three to five OpenAI-form tool definitions.
GET /billing returns your plan, its limits and what this period has used.
The dashboard, CLI, Python, or a coding agent with your API key.
Generate tool-calling training data, fine-tune Needle 3, and download the resulting models.
